feature_sources.parsed_fev1_l: selected acceptable A/B raw manoeuvre decoded through its observed endpoint
feature_sources.parsed_fvc_l: terminal cumulative volume of the same full selected raw manoeuvre
feature_sources.duration_s: observed duration of the same full selected raw manoeuvre
feature_sources.age_years: Cycle F merged NHANES demographic summary
feature_sources.height_cm: Cycle F merged NHANES body-measure summary
feature_sources.sex: Cycle F merged NHANES demographic summary
feature_sources.target_fvc_l: released Cycle F summary best-test SPXNFVC divided by 1000

selection_audit.alpha: selected by five deterministic participant folds within Cycle F TRAIN
selection_audit.imputation_and_scaling: estimated inside each ridge fit from its fitting fold or full TRAIN partition
selection_audit.matched_coverage: uses the number of finalized cases in the Cycle F policy-development TEST result; ranking uses test features but not test labels
selection_audit.fixed_specificity: threshold is selected on TRAIN, but its target specificity is copied from the Cycle F policy-development TEST result
selection_audit.policy_status: the physics policy itself was iteratively compared on Cycle F TEST, so its final TEST metrics are development estimates

leakage_verdict.explanation: The ridge target is released summary FVC, while parsed_fvc_l is the terminal volume of the full selected same-session manoeuvre. This is not train/test record leakage, but it supplies a direct near-target proxy and therefore is not a clean censored-prefix comparator for latent FVC recovery.

comparability_verdict.ridge_information: one selected full manoeuvre plus age, height, and sex
comparability_verdict.physics_information: selected waveform fit plus repeated-manoeuvre fits, acceptability, repeatability, and ATS-derived state
comparability_verdict.conclusion: The existing matched-coverage numbers compare decisions on the same participant universe, but they do not isolate estimator value under equal information. A frozen cross-cycle study must report both the archived ridge and an endpoint-censored ridge using the same observation window as the physics estimator.

bootstrap_verdict: The 2,000-replicate percentile bootstrap is participant-level because each table has one row per participant. It conditions on the fitted ridge model and does not include training-sample uncertainty or paired confidence intervals for method differences.
